source_caveats: Both Excel documents label class schedules as tentative or expected: publication requires independent owner review
Standard workbook header appears to repeat cohort 41, but actual data contains cohorts 40,41,42
Advanced workbook draft header says year 2027 although named online notice/file is in Nov 2026
No instructors are populated: do not reuse instructor data from other semesters
Advanced programs alone specify online study on Feb 15-20, 2027; do not impose on standard classes
78 advanced practical/software exam dates Jul 19-21 fall in summer week 1; timetable explicitly includes THI PM then
Four standard classes show 25 Apr exam although standard timeline does not mark an exam on Sun 25 Apr; check announcement before publish
15 advanced PHONG THI cells contain adjustment markers (not physical exam rooms); keep marker in source notes, do not display as room
Do not mark whole week 9,11,12,21 as holiday; closures/events occur on specific dates only
Do NOT run scripts/seed-course-schedules-d1.mjs on production: it deletes all rows before seeding
